scope: Supplied before --controller code in the assembled module. Lexical controller scope, not a Window API; standalone recipe helpers are separate unless explicitly concatenated. Implementation: base-ui assets/ui-runtime.js plus assets/review-runtime-adapter.js; assets/prototype-runtime.js is a generated compatibility bundle.

capabilities.name: registerPrototype
capabilities.prerequisites: Unique actual leaf ID; cloneable state, reducer and render callbacks. Register using the supplied lexical registerPrototype; document-wide startup closures do not bind preview DOM. Query mounted root only inside render/bind.
capabilities.timing: Register once before shell mount. bind is scoped to root and aborted on unmount.
capabilities.result: No value; invalid/duplicate registration throws. dispatch commits synchronous state/render.
capabilities.limits: Session state per leaf/proposal; no cross-leaf sync or reload persistence.

callbacks.render: render(root,state): mounted leaf Element and cloned state; synchronous committed paint
callbacks.reduce: reduce(state,action): cloned state and dispatched action; return cloneable next state
callbacks.bind: bind({root,on,dispatch,signal}): one object argument; return cleanup function or undefined
callbacks.on: on(type,selector,handler): delegated root listener; handler(event,target,dispatch); target is matching contained Element
callbacks.dispatch: dispatch(action): reduce then synchronously repaint matching mounted views
callbacks.cleanup: Listeners registered through on abort on unmount; cleanup() releases other resources. signal is AbortSignal. No Window API.

capabilities.name: revisePrototypePlan
capabilities.result: Patched state with incremented planRevision and approvedRevision=null.
capabilities.limits: Caller identifies consequential edits; helper does not validate domain data.

capabilities.name: approvePrototypePlan
capabilities.result: State with approvedRevision equal to current planRevision.
capabilities.limits: Local approval only; no operational authorization.

capabilities.name: prototypePlanApproved
capabilities.timing: Read current local approval during render/reduce.
capabilities.result: Boolean current revision matches non-null approval.

capabilities.name: focusWorkflowStep
capabilities.prerequisites: Connected visible destination heading in ordered [data-step]/[data-stage] panels, or explicit selector.
capabilities.timing: After committed Next/Back render only; never initial mount, typing or every render.
capabilities.result: Sets tabindex=-1, focuses destination heading, returns actual focus success; false for absent/disconnected/hidden target.
capabilities.limits: Not automatic; caller supplies actual destination index and verifies activation. Asynchronous renders must complete first.
